sourceNote: MODELLED magnitude on a MEASURED shape. PGCB publishes hourly system generation by fuel (erp.powergrid.gov.bd), not curtailment; Bangladesh publishes no curtailment feed and no national curtailment rate. The 24-hour profile is the UTC hour-of-day mean of 51 hourly PGCB solar-generation readings covering 2026-09-03T18:00:00.000Z to 2026-09-06T06:00:00.000Z (peak 607 MW), rescaled so it integrates to an ESTIMATED 0.1 TWh/yr curtailment anchor — the repo's own figure, unchanged from the previous BPDB fallback and not attributable to any published source. Against the generation in this window that anchor implies a 8.86% curtailment rate; treat that as the number to challenge. Energy totals are therefore modelled, not measured.
